NasaGalleyAPI.subtitle: Vanilla JS · NASA Open API
NasaGalleyAPI.description: My very first web app: lets users search the vast NASA Gallery through its public APIs.

SBLProject.name: SimpleBookLibrary + SBLMobile
SBLProject.subtitle: Personal library manager
SBLProject.description: A simple library manager to keep track of books, authors, and reading status. It includes a web app and a mobile companion app.
SBLProject.more: Born as a personal project to manage my own book collection, it was later upgraded to include a mobile companion app for Android developed with the help of my colleague.

MinixGames.name: MinixGames
MinixGames.subtitle: Mini games for Max fun
MinixGames.description: A collection of mini browser games built with vanilla JS, HTML, and CSS, designed for quick entertainment to enjoy single player or multiplayer sessions with friends.
